dogecoin.text: Once I had my Gears, the real fun began. I jumped into the Midl swap dApp at https://t.co/apS4NoLY5r and converted test BTC into tokens like $DOG, $LOBO, or $DOGE. Each token represents a side in The Bag Wars, and the one that ends up with the highest market cap takes the crown.
